result.summary: The food-delivery home screen is mostly coherent, but there are several visual/content defects: a typo in the search placeholder, clipped text in the horizontal 'Fastest near you' carousel, inconsistent favourite-button and card-image styling, and a horizontally cut-off category chip row that gives no affordance that more filters exist.

issues.description: Search field placeholder reads 'Restarants, dishes, groceries' — 'Restarants' is misspelled (should be 'Restaurants').
issues.suggestion: Correct the placeholder copy to 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries' and add a spell check to UI string resources.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel the third card is hard-cut at the right screen edge and its title renders as 'Trattoria Piccol' with no ellipsis, and its price line is also clipped, making it look broken rather than scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Ensure carousel items keep consistent card width with a visible peek (e.g. 16–24px) and truncate labels with an ellipsis so partially visible cards read as intentional.

issues.description: The favourite (heart) buttons are styled inconsistently: the Tokumaru Ramen card uses a white circular button with a dark outline heart, while the pizza card below uses a dark/translucent circle with a white heart.
issues.suggestion: Standardise the favourite button to one background/icon treatment across all cards, or make it contrast-aware with an identical scrim for every image.

issues.description: The 'Green Bowl Poké' thumbnail has a light grey background while the sibling cards use dark photographic backgrounds, so the row looks visually uneven and the white '15–25 min' badge has weak contrast against it.
issues.suggestion: Apply a consistent image treatment/gradient scrim to all thumbnails and use a badge style with sufficient contrast on light imagery.

issues.description: The category filter chips ('All, Pizza, Sushi, Burgers, Healthy…') are cut off at the right edge with a sliver of the next chip, giving no clear scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Add a fade/gradient mask or chevron at the edge of the scrollable chip row, and align the cut so a chip is meaningfully peeking.

issues.description: The second restaurant card (pizza) is abruptly truncated by the bottom tab bar with no bottom padding, so the card appears cropped instead of scrolled.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content inset equal to the tab bar height so cards can scroll fully clear of the navigation bar.

issues.description: Cards in 'Fastest near you' show only delivery time and fee, while 'Popular right now' cards show rating and cuisine — inconsistent metadata makes the lists feel unfinished.
issues.suggestion: Show a consistent metadata set (rating, ETA, fee) on all restaurant cards or intentionally define compact vs. full card variants.
